prompt_meta.title: Best-in-class UI/UX Overhaul (Web + Mobile) + Proof-based QA + E2E stays Green + GitHub push

product_identity.brand_positioning: Premium, modern, playful-but-professional sports social platform (best-in-class UX in Korea)

owner_actions.when: after IDE shares screenshots and short walkthrough notes in report
owner_actions.instruction: Review the best-in-class UI screenshots for web + mobile and approve or request changes. No command execution.
owner_actions.expected_output: APPROVE_UI or UI_CHANGES_REQUESTED with bullet feedback

step_objectives.goal: Transform NoriJjak into a premium, best-in-class product experience. Web + Mobile must feel like a top-tier Korean consumer app with exceptional polish and intuitive flows. Provide proof-based QA evidence that everything still works end-to-end.
outcomes: A coherent, premium design system with consistent typography, spacing, iconography, elevation, and motion
A world-class information architecture: navigation is obvious, content hierarchy is clear, key actions are always reachable
Delightful but restrained microinteractions (hover/press, transitions, skeletons, optimistic updates where safe)
Fast-feeling UX: perceived performance improvements via skeletons, caching, pagination, and smart loading
High-quality forms: inline validation, clear error copy, disabled/active states, password UX, and success toasts
Best-in-class empty states: helpful CTAs, examples, and “start here” guidance
Proof-based QA: hard evidence of Web E2E, emulator run, and key flows captured as assets
All gates remain green; pushed to GitHub main
constraints: Do not add new domain features or change backend contracts unless strictly required to support UX (minor fixes allowed).
All new user-visible strings must be localized via the shared dictionary.
No visual regressions: avoid random styling; everything must be systemized.
definition_of_done: Web looks like a premium consumer product (not dev scaffolding): app shell, dashboards, cards, filters, modals, toasts, skeletons, and cohesive branding
Mobile looks premium: polished navigation, card layouts, consistent components, and smooth interactions
Screenshots demonstrate best-in-class UI across the required screens (web + Android emulator; iOS if feasible)
Web Playwright E2E passes via automated run and evidence is captured
Root gates pass: integrity/lint/test/build + web e2e
Changes committed and pushed to GitHub main

global_principles: Design for comfort: big tap targets, clear spacing, readable text, calm hierarchy
One primary action per screen; secondary actions are discoverable but not noisy
Reduce cognitive load: progressive disclosure (details reveal only when needed)
Consistency: same components, same patterns everywhere
Korean consumer app polish: clean, subtle shadows, rounded corners, soft separators, delightful micro-motion
must_have_modern_patterns: App Shell with persistent navigation (web) and bottom tabs (mobile)
Command palette or quick action launcher (web) OR quick action FAB (mobile) for create/join
Smart filters with chips and clear reset
Skeleton loading + shimmer-like effect (implementation up to IDE)
Optimistic UI updates for low-risk actions (e.g., marking notification read)
Sticky key actions (e.g., Join/Request) on detail pages
Share UX: compact, beautiful share cards or share sheets trigger points
Avatar + badge visuals on profiles and lists

web.component_system: IDE chooses a modern system (e.g., shadcn/ui) and enforces consistent tokens
layout: Top bar with search + notifications + profile
Left nav or tabbed nav for main modules (Games, Clubs, Venues, Notifications, Profile)
ui_elements_required: Modals/drawers for create/join actions when appropriate
Empty state illustrations or tasteful iconography (no heavy images required)

mobile.theme: Single theme provider with consistent tokens (typography, spacing, colors)
navigation: Bottom tabs: Games, Clubs, Venues, Notifications, Profile
Consistent header styling and back behavior
ui_elements_required: Sticky bottom CTA on detail pages
Delight animations for button press / transitions (lightweight)

web: Games: list (search/filter), detail (sticky action), create (guided form)
Venues: list/detail (amenities + map link CTA styling)
Chat (clean bubble UI + safety actions unobtrusive)

ux_quality_must_include: Loading state for every list/detail view
Empty state for every list view with a helpful CTA
Error state + retry for API calls
Toasts/snackbars for actions (join, approve, report, rate)
Form validation with friendly copy and disabled submit until valid
Accessibility: focus rings (web), readable contrast, aria labels where applicable
Perceived performance: skeletons + cache where reasonable

evidence_assets_required: Playwright automated run output (stdout/stderr tails) + HTML report path (if generated)
At least 12 web screenshots covering key flows and screens
Android emulator boot proof + at least 12 mobile screenshots across key screens
If iOS feasible: at least 8 iOS screenshots; else capture exact blocker output (commands + errors) as logs
web_e2e_minimum_flows: Create game -> see it in list -> open detail
Join/request join -> notification created -> open notification -> navigates correctly
mobile_proof_minimum_flows_android: Login -> games list -> open game detail -> open chat
Open notifications tab -> tap an item -> navigates correctly

tasks.name: Design system foundation (Web + Mobile)
tasks.objective: Introduce a cohesive premium design system with tokens and shared UI patterns. Refactor existing screens to use system components consistently.
acceptance: All key screens use the design system components

tasks.name: Web UI overhaul (premium app shell + polished screens)
tasks.objective: Transform web UI into premium product experience across required screens with modern patterns (filters, cards, modals, toasts, skeletons, empty/error states).
constraints: No new features; only UX/polish and minor bug fixes
acceptance: No broken navigation; flows remain functional

tasks.name: Mobile UI overhaul (premium look + comfort UX)
tasks.objective: Transform mobile UI into premium experience with theme, polished navigation, sticky CTAs, pull-to-refresh, toasts, skeletons, and refined components.
acceptance: 12+ Android emulator screenshots show premium UI

tasks.name: Proof-based QA run (Web E2E + evidence)
tasks.objective: Run Playwright E2E in automation and store evidence assets and outputs under reports/assets/STEP-0018/.
constraints: No manual claims; must be automated

tasks.name: Proof-based simulator run (Android emulator mandatory; iOS best-effort)
tasks.objective: Boot Android emulator and capture evidence. Attempt iOS simulator and capture evidence or exact blocker logs.
acceptance: Android proof exists; iOS proof or clear blocker logs exist

tasks.name: Performance basics + build sanity
tasks.objective: Ensure web/mobile feel fast: reduce unnecessary re-renders, add caching where safe, keep bundle reasonable. Ensure build remains green.
constraints: Do not add heavy dependencies without justification
acceptance: pnpm -r build passes; major screens feel snappy; report includes perf notes

tasks.name: Gates + GitHub push
tasks.objective: Run all gates, fix any failures, commit and push to main, keep CI green.
acceptance: Commit hash + push evidence in report

final_instruction_to_ide: Execute this prompt exactly. Do not ask the owner to run commands. Overhaul Web + Mobile UI to best-in-class premium UX (modern patterns, delight, comfort, consistency). Add loading/empty/error states everywhere, toasts, refined forms, and professional navigation. Capture hard proof assets (screenshots + automated Playwright output + emulator proof). Keep all gates green, commit and push to GitHub main, update ops/manifest.json, and write a complete reports/STEP-0018.report.json with no placeholders.
